measurement: Isolated MLX checkpoint weight load; no vLLM server or inference

scope.included: Evaluated model parameter arrays, including packed quantized weights, scales, biases and any unquantized parameters
scope.excluded: vLLM server/KV allocations, inference activations, HTTP serving, and process RSS
scope.precision_control: Checkpoint dtypes preserved exactly; no cast requested
scope.load_timing: Local mlx_lm.load(lazy=False), tokenizer construction, explicit parameter evaluation, and GPU synchronization; filesystem cache state is uncontrolled
scope.logical_tensor_bytes: Sum of array.nbytes across model.parameters(); includes quantization metadata arrays and could count shared storage more than once
scope.unique_parameter_buffer_bytes: MLX allocator size of unique backing buffers for evaluated model parameters
scope.active_allocation: MLX allocator active bytes; excludes cached buffers and is not system RSS
scope.peak_allocation: Peak active allocation since resetting immediately before model load; may include transient loader/model initialization arrays
